conventions.interpretive_error: E: N or M; C: O; X treated as missing. Sensitivity: P counted as error.
conventions.auc_direction: higher predictor value = higher error risk; mean confidence reversed
conventions.pooled_bootstrap: segments resampled as clusters (both models' observations together)
conventions.medium_confidence: paired analyses drop the whole pair; unpaired analyses drop the E segment
conventions.d_prime: lenient read rate vs over-interpretation rate, log-linear correction in every cell
conventions.calibration: run-1 confidence of the scored response, 5-point bins
conventions.kappa: E: unweighted on F/P/N/M/X; linear weights on read score (F2 P1 N0 M0) on items neither scorer coded X. C: unweighted on A/O/X; raw agreement reported
